plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp build for boxing with one weekly S&C session. Week 1 establishes training maxes on the main lift so percentage work can start cleanly in Week 2. Weeks 2-3 build lower-body force, upper-body pushing and pulling strength, basic power, and a small conditioning dose without creating too much soreness for boxing. Week 4 is a deload with lower volume so you can recover and carry momentum into the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength first, keep basic explosive work in, and add a small conditioning dose that does not interfere with boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power work while keeping lifting volume tight enough to recover well alongside boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more of the work toward faster and sharper output while keeping enough strength work to hold onto the force gains.
